text:
sre-bot: ALERT: SLO burn detected for api.gateway.latency P99 and increased 5xx rate across hosted inference (window 5m). Alert id: sg-2167801234.

maria: saw it hit ~2.3% 5xx over the last 10m, P99 latency jumped from 120ms->950ms. dashboards/ingress -> spike on edge -> backend 5xx.

jonathan: incoming support ticket (SUP-78924) — customer A reports repeated timeouts and billing errors (charges for requests that errored). They included a curl repro.

anika: copying customer repro here (redacted keys):
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"open-instruct-3b","input":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```
They see 502 / connection reset. Happened across 3 regions but primarily us-east-1.

maria: quick checks: no recent infra deploys in the last hour per deploy-bot. Gateway requests that hit authz are returning 504/502.

lee: running log query for root cause, pulling 5xx grouped by upstream component. Query (Loki/LogQL):
```
{job="api-gateway"} |= "upstream_status" | json | stats count() by upstream_service, upstream_status | sort by _count desc
```
Results: authz-service returned most 504s (authz->user-lookup), followed by kvcache proxy returning 502 on long-tail requests.

lee: trace sampling is low right now — our APM shows a gap for the 2167801200-2167803000 window. Only 1% of requests sampled, likely why full traces are sparse.

jonathan: support-bot attached user's request IDs: rq_0452, rq_0453, rq_0459. Any chance these hit a throttled route or a billing enforcement path?

anika: user claims they were billed for attempts that returned 5xx — need to validate billing pipeline but also prevent more customer impact.

maria: mitigation suggestions: 1) temporarily raise gateway upstream timeout from 3s -> 10s for authz path, 2) enable cached fallback for common authz responses, 3) increase trace sampling to 10% for next 20m to gather traces. Which order?

lee: prefer sampling + read-only cache fallback first (low risk). Timeout raise is higher blast radius but could reduce 5xxs. We should toggle cache TTL to 30s for user-lookup.

jonathan: can we repro locally? I tried replaying headers from support logs against staging authz and got similar latency spike when replaying at 200 rps. Looks like user-lookup V2 hitting an external identity provider that started throttling.

maria: that matches. external-idp had a degraded window. So the authz gets delayed and gateway times out -> 502/504 at edge.

deploy-bot: no active rollout blocking. Canary window clear. Ready to apply config changes on request.

anika: for customer-facing, I'm going to open a bridge and tell customer we're investigating and may implement temporary retry/backoff on our side.

maria: action plan (short):
- lee: push read-only cache TTL increase for authz-service -> 30s (config flag) (ETA 5m)
- lee: increase trace sampling to 10% for next 30m (ETA 2m)
- maria: if 5xx rate not improved in 10m, raise gateway upstream timeout for authz from 3s to 10s and enable fallback route to local-policy (ETA 5m)
- anika: coordinate with support and notify customer at T+10m

lee: pushed cache flag to authz staging, promoting to prod. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/authz AUTHZ_CACHE_TTL=30 --namespace=prod`

lee: enabled sampling in APM: `apm sampling set --service api-gateway --rate 0.1`

maria: starting timeout bump canary on one gateway shard now (shard-7). will monitor error rate and latency.

deploy-bot: canary started: gateway-config-timeout=10s on shard-7. Observability link: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/gateway/timeout-canary?panel=error_rate&from=now-30m (placeholder)

lee: after cache + sampling + canary timeout bump: 5xx rate dropped from 2.3% -> 0.6% in 6m on shard-7. P99 also dropped 950ms->220ms.

anika: told customer we'll apply a short-term fix and then follow up with root cause & credits. They acknowledged, appreciate the quick response.

maria: good. next steps: revert sampling after capture window, keep TTL increase for 24h while idp stabilizes, follow up with idp ops to understand throttling. Create incident (INC-21678) and assign postmortem owner.

jonathan: billing follow-up: need a query to find requests that errored but were billed. lee, can you run a join between request logs and billing events for the window 2167801000-2167804600? Suggested query (bigquery):
```
SELECT r.request_id, r.user_id, b.invoice_id, b.amount, r.status
FROM `prod.logs.requests` r
LEFT JOIN `billing.events` b ON r.request_id = b.request_id
WHERE r.timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(2167801000) AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(2167804600)
  AND r.status LIKE '%5%'
```

lee: running now. Initial sample: 12 requests with 5xx have billing entries. I'll dump ids to support slack thread for refunds.

maria: thumbs up. Also add config task to add a short-circuit in gateway: if authz is degraded and user has cached allow, skip remote call. Low-risk perf optimization.

anika: customer update posted: "we're applying a short-term fix to reduce timeouts and will issue refunds for affected calls; full RCA soon."

maria: closing the on-call bridge in 40m once metrics remain stable. Create postmortem and link to INC-21678. Owners: maria (lead), lee (observability), anika (customer comm), jonathan (billing).

maria: tl;dr: root cause external idp throttling -> authz latency -> gateway timeouts & 5xx spike. Mitigations: cache TTL increase, temporary gateway timeout bump, trace sampling for capture, billing refunds for affected requests.

jonathan: thanks all. I'll follow up with a backlog ticket for gateway short-circuit and improved provenance tags on traces so we don't lose trace coverage in future.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-78924 updated: customer notified, refund queued for invoice INV-100932.

maria: ACK — will schedule postmortem doc and close incident after RCA. :white_check_mark:

lee: leaving a couple notes: add alert to detect 'probe vs real' divergence: probe latency fine but real traffic P99 high -> indicates authz/backpressure vs synthetic probe gap. I'll add a dashboard panel.

anika: thanks team, will send the customer follow-up next week with the RCA.

sre-bot: INCIDENT INC-21678 declared (severity: P1), runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/incidents/authz-timeout (placeholder)

maria: end of thread for now, will reopen if anything changes.
